changes.summary: Brave web searches no longer fail with HTTP 404: the Api-Version header is sent only when a caller pins apiVersion, and a web search with no results is reported as empty instead of malformed.
Declare provider capabilities, reject unsupported filters before network calls, and provide a Brave configuration recipe and guarded search agent tool.
SearchRequest accepts explicit optional filters, SearchProvider may declare capabilities, and the search manifest configures a Brave runtime.
Provider-neutral search evidence, Brave Web and LLM Context adapters, explicit attempt outcomes and scoped caching
